description: This file contains utility functions and type definitions for handling model compatibility, including applying patches, normalizing URLs, and detecting model types within a plugin system.

methods.name: extractModelCompat
methods.description: Extracts the ModelCompatConfig object from a model or compatibility object.

methods.name: applyModelCompatPatch
methods.description: Applies a patch to the model's compatibility configuration.

methods.name: hasToolSchemaProfile
methods.description: Checks if the model's compatibility configuration has a specific tool schema profile.

methods.name: hasNativeWebSearchTool
methods.description: Determines if the model's compatibility configuration indicates support for native web search tool.

methods.name: resolveToolCallArgumentsEncoding
methods.description: Resolves the tool call arguments encoding from the model's compatibility configuration.

methods.name: resolveUnsupportedToolSchemaKeywords
methods.description: Returns a set of unsupported tool schema keywords from the model's compatibility configuration.

methods.name: normalizeModelCompat
methods.description: Normalizes the model object, especially URL and compatibility settings, for consistent usage.
